notes: Recorded as a refutation because the domain reads as a free VPS provider and several lists classify it that way. Applying requires filling in real personal details for an evaluation, and the fee is per VPS rather than per member. A one-week trial before paying is offered. The playground VPS has a one-month lifetime and the staging VPS three months, which is the only genuinely free capacity here.
